description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Thran Dynamo.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.
